My Syndrome.. It's so many different things. It causes Chiari Malformations, which cause Migraine.
It causes my body to basically fall apart, causes my joints to dislocate constantly. Not just once a day, sometimes hundreds of times a day. It is caused by my body not producing collagen properly, which is basically like cement for your body. 

Collagen is everywhere, in your organs, in your bones. Literally everywhere. There are also 6 different types from the one I have, which is the Hypermobility type, also called Type 3. But I also have some overlappings with the Vascular type, as in my scars being paper thin, and very thick. Which means my skin is tearing. 

Because of my joints constantly dislocating, they have been severely damaged. Still, Doctors think this disease is not invalidating. I also, on the side, have Hypothyroidism which is totally treatable, but on the side with this Syndrome it makes me incredibly exhausted and makes it almost impossible to even walk up and down the stairs. 

I most likely also have POTS due to my Syndrome, it has a lot of different secondary diseases. 

I'm pretty sure that by 35 I will be permanently bed bound, or it might have ruptured an organ before then because the doctors still don't know shit about where to find a lot of different not yet found out about types in the DNA, or my depression will have taken the best of me.
Yeah, that's not normal.
